title.narrative: Developing the Economic Cooperation Zone Project

description.narrative: The project aims to operationalize the Zamyn-Uud free zone and support the development of the Zamyn-Uud-Erenhot cross-border economic zone, through: (i) construction of infrastructure and facilities; (ii) strengthened management and operation; and (iii) establishment of a CBEZ port of entry system. The project is expected to improve Mongolia's regional trade and investment linkages particularly in CAREC corridor.

Output: Zamyn-Uud free zone infrastructure and facilities constructed and operational Indicator: By 2027: 1a. about 3 kilometers of primary four-lane and secondary two-lane roads with sidewalks and streetlights; underground pipes for heating, water supply, and wastewater collection; power transmission lines; solid waste management station and recycling center; and security fence constructed (2019 baseline: 0) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Q4 2025: Contract award for for CW-02, covering the construction of a 1.2 km two-lane road in Zamyn-Uud, has been delayed. During bid evaluation, the DED consulting firm identified an error in the calculation of road layer thickness, which required an upward revision of engineering cost estimates by MNT1.3 billion (approximately $360,465). As a result, the executing agency issued instructions on 1 October 2025 to rebid the package. The revised estimates were verified and approved by the Road and Transport Development Center on 3 October 2025, and the final bid evaluation report was submitted to ADB on 7 October 2025. ADB approved the rebidding on 20 October 2025, with the new bidding process advertised on 5 November 2025 and bid submissions scheduled for 5 December 2025. As of end of Q4 2025, the EA has not submitted the BER for the package. -------------------- Q3 2025: - Contract for for CW-03: Underground infrastructure construction work (3 Lots) valued at $10.4 million awarded in September 2025. - IFB for CW-02 (1.4 km road) advertised on 8 August and closed on 8 September 2025. - The DED for solid waste management station and recycling center is 80% complete. ------------------ Q2 2025: IFB for CW-03: Underground infrastructure construction work (3 Lots) was advertised on 20 June, deadline for submission of bids was 9 July 2025.
DED of Lot 1 for CW-02: DED for Roads' construction work has been approved. The BEC was established on 7 July. The DBD was submitted to ADB for review, while the DED for Lot 2 is delayed pending agreement on the border crossing point between the Zamyn-Uud Free Economic Zone (ZUFEZ) and Erlian City. Data Source: Progress and completion reports from the PIU and contractors
